Name: Er
Summary: Er was the firstborn son of Judah by the daughter of Shuah, and the first husband of Tamar.
KeyStory: Er was wicked in the sight of the LORD, and the LORD put him to death in Canaan before the family went to Egypt.
RelatedPeople: Judah; Tamar; Onan; Shelah, Son of Judah
LifeLesson: A firstborn's place is no guarantee: what matters is a heart turned toward God.
